cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our table-tennis rematch decides who cleans up. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And whose cleaning method we use all year.

mechanism: A negotiates a table-tennis rematch by granting serve and wording control while escalating cleanup into year-long method control and public witnesses.
confusable: Unlike one larger bet, each new choice adds another consequence or audience.
comparison: Annual club cleaning policy and witnessed terms differ from public names beside a neighbourhood snack.
seedUse: D216-a rematch, cleaning method and club witnesses; S02-a gives B serve and wording control to keep agreement possible.
